question:
An open box is to be made from a square sheet of side $24\ \text{cm}$ by cutting equal squares of side $x\ \text{cm}$ from each corner and folding the remaining portions.

(a) Form the volume function and state the permissible interval for $x$.

(b) Determine the value of $x$ for which the volume is maximum using the second derivative test.

(c) Find the dimensions and maximum volume of the box.

(a)
After cutting and folding, the height is $x\ \text{cm}$, while the length and breadth are each $(24-2x)\ \text{cm}$. Therefore,
$$V(x)=x(24-2x)^2$$

At $x=4$,

Hence, the volume is maximum when $x=4\ \text{cm}$.

(c)
The dimensions of the box are
$$24-2(4)=16\ \text{cm}$$
Therefore, the box has length $16\ \text{cm}$, breadth $16\ \text{cm}$ and height $4\ \text{cm}$. Its maximum volume is
$$V(4)=4(16)^2=1024\ \text{cm}^3$$
